name: Old Town Centre
tagline: Walled heart around the main square
description: The restored core inside the 18th-century walls, gathered around the main square and the tower-topped ramparts. Cobbled lanes, red-roofed houses, guesthouses, wine bars and cafes make this the most walkable, atmospheric and convenient place to base yourself.
bestFor: Visitors wanting walkable convenience, wine bars and the most scenic, central base
pros: Best cafes, wine bars and guesthouses

name: Bodbe Monastery Area
tagline: Peaceful hillside beside the famous monastery
description: The tranquil area just outside town around the Bodbe Monastery, set among cypress trees and gardens with sweeping valley views. Quieter and more spiritual than the centre, it suits those wanting calm, greenery and a short walk or taxi into Sighnaghi.
bestFor: Quiet-seekers and slow travellers wanting calm, gardens and monastery views
cons: Needs a walk or taxi into town

name: Lower Valley-View Streets
tagline: Sloping lanes toward the Alazani panoramas
description: The lower streets descending from the centre toward the valley viewpoints, where terraces and windows open onto the Alazani plain and the Caucasus beyond. Slightly removed from the square, these quieter lanes trade convenience for some of the town's finest outlooks.
bestFor: Those prioritising panoramic views and a calmer, more local residential feel

name: Kakheti Wine Villages
tagline: Surrounding vineyards toward Tsnori and Telavi
description: The wider wine country around Sighnaghi, including nearby Tsnori and the road toward Telavi. Vineyards, family cellars and rural guesthouses spread across the valley, offering an authentic, affordable countryside base for anyone touring Kakheti's qvevri winemaking heartland.
bestFor: Wine lovers and drivers wanting an authentic, affordable rural countryside base
